title: Food intolerance test
what: This is a blood test from a vein. The lab checks how your immune system reacts to different foods.
why: Usually at the patient's own request, for bloating, tiredness, or skin problems. Doctors are cautious about this test.
duration: the blood draw takes 3 to 5 minutes; results usually come in 3 to 10 days
tell_doctor: If you take steroids or medicines that weaken the immune system
If you already have a confirmed food allergy
What symptoms you have and after which foods

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: Usually fasting, or a few hours after a meal. Check with the lab.

prepare.title: Diet
prepare.text: Do not cut foods out before the test. Otherwise the result will not be accurate.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop them on your own. Tell your doctor what you take.

bring: Your referral, if you have one
steps: You sit down and rest your arm on the armrest
A band is tightened above your elbow, and the skin is wiped
Blood is drawn into a tube
The needle comes out, and a cotton pad is pressed on
feel: A quick prick, like a pinch
after: Press the cotton pad for 3 to 5 minutes
Results usually come in 3 to 10 days
Do not cut foods from your diet based on this test alone. Discuss the result with your doctor

faq.q: How is this different from an allergy test?
faq.a: An allergy test looks for other antibodies linked to real reactions. This test often just shows what you eat often.

faq.q: Can I go on a diet based on the result?
faq.a: Not on your own. You could miss out on foods you need. Better to discuss a diet with your doctor.

reminders.text: Food intolerance test tomorrow. Eat as usual and check if you need to come fasting.
